spans.s:
मूत a. [मू-क्त]
1 Bound, tied
--2 Confined.
--3 Woven.
--तः --तं
1 A woven basket (Ved.).
--2 A
woven band of cloth.
--3 A lump,
collection.

; मूत्रं चकार ‘made water’.
--Comp.
--आघातः a urinary disease.
--आशयः the lower belly.
--उत्संग
see मूत्रसंग --कृच्छ्र painful discharge
of urine, strangury.
--कोशः the
scrotum.
--क्षयः insufficient
secretion of urine.
--ग्रथिः a knot or
induration on the neck of the
bladder.
--जठरः --रं the swelling of the
belly caused by retention of urine.
--दोषः a urinary disease.
--निरोधः
retention of urine.
--पतनः a
civetcat.
--पथः the urinary passage.
--परीक्षा uroscopy or examination
of urine.
--पुटं the lewer belly
--मार्गः, --प्रसेकः the urethra.
--वर्धक
a. diuretic.
--वृद्धिः f. copious
secretion of urine.
--शकृत् n. urine
and excrement.
--शुक्रं a disease in
which semen is discharged along
with urine.
--शूलः --लं urinary colic.
--संगः urinary obstruction, a
painful and bloody discharge of urine.

मूत्रयति Den. P. To make
water; तिष्ठन्मूत्रयति Mbh.

मूत्रल a. Promoting the secretion
of urine, diuretic.

मूत्रित a.
1 Discharged or voided
as urine.
--2 Soiled with urine.
